title: Complete Thiel-company employee → WEF cross-match — depth 2
summary: Enumerate every publicly named current and former employee across direct Thiel-linked firms and test each identity against all official WEF programmes, meetings, profiles, councils, publications and Global Shapers records.

data.target: All-level employee enumeration and WEF cross-match
objectives: Enumerate every publicly named Palantir employee from SEC filings, company authors, patents, lobbying disclosures, PAC records, procurement contacts, archived team pages and conference rosters.
Cross-match all 28 current Founders Fund personnel against WEF profiles, meetings, Young Global Leaders, Global Shapers, councils, reports, initiatives and archived PDFs.
Acquire current and historical rosters for Thiel Capital, Mithril, Clarium and Valar and normalize every role.
Resolve all names against the existing 4,062-person Global Shapers alumni corpus.
Enumerate contractors, advisers, directors, recruiters, legal, finance, communications, operations and technical staff—not only leadership.
Recurse confirmed employee hits into WEF meetings, councils, initiatives, authored outputs, government positions, NGOs, portfolio companies and policy outcomes.
required_rules: Do not treat no search result as proof of no WEF tie.
Do not flatten profiles, meeting participation, YGL, Shapers, councils, employment or organization partnership into one generic membership predicate.
Do not infer ideological agreement, direction or control from WEF participation alone.
Publish every recursion depth as a separate pass in dataset wef.
selection_reason: User-directed standing requirement to enumerate employees at all levels in all future Thiel-company passes.
